extraction_notes: The job identity was preserved exactly: frozen campaign order 945, LCSC C179626, MPN NTMFS5C670NLT1G, manufacturer onsemi, family mosfet.
The canonical PDF identifies NTMFS5C670NL as a single N-channel MOSFET and shows May, 2019 - Rev. 1. All seven PDF pages were examined.
Threshold voltage has published minimum and maximum values but no typical value in the electrical-characteristics table, so threshold_typ is null.

The electrical-characteristics table lists body-diode forward voltage as 0.9 V typical and 1.2 V maximum at TJ = 25 °C, plus 0.8 V typical at TJ = 125 °C. The schema's single body_diode slot records the published maximum at TJ = 25 °C.
Curve points are conservative digitizations of visible plotted traces and grid locations only. Figure temperatures are recorded only where explicitly labeled; no curve values were extrapolated.
